messages.content: PEFT refers to a set of techniques in NLP that fine-tunes large pretrained language models by updating only a tiny fraction (often <1%) of their parameters, drastically reducing memory footprint and computational cost.

LoRA (Low-Rank Adaptation) freezes the pretrained model weights and injects trainable rank decomposition matrices into each layer of the Transformer architecture, reducing the number of trainable parameters for downstream tasks by up to 10,000 times.
